import hashlib,json,os,stat,sys

        with open(target,'"'"'rb'"'"') as stream:data=stream.read()

    rows.append(row)
print(json.dumps({'"'"'paths'"'"':rows,'"'"'hash_policy'"'"':'"'"'file_bytes_or_symlink_target_bytes'"'"'}))
